# PostgreSQL migrations

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-readme.js -->

The application supplies a typed SSOT with explicit SQL mappings and database connections for initialUser, owner and appUser.
The CLI supports capture, assess, infer, generate, data, resolve, status and apply without a project adapter.

Each migration has numbered SQL and metadata.json, including initial owner/app setup and ordered permissions.
Passwords remain in connection settings; metadata preserves checks, snapshots and frozen validators.

Commands are non-interactive; unresolved changes return structured errors and remain pending.

Apply verifies immutable files, catalog/history integrity and recorded-head drift, then uses locked owner transactions.
Schema, data and permissions are checked before history/pointer success; failures retain their durable outcome.
Ambiguous changes remain pending until draft-bound decisions are supplied. Standalone data SQL requires explicit effects.

Drafts and immutable artifacts share typed boundary decoders; semantic checks use the decoded values.
Manual and data authoring share dependency traversal while preserving their existing ordering policies.

The library examples exercise generated-only, manual and mixed schema/data migrations on owned scratch databases.
The SSOT CLI integration covers fresh roles, DML-only app access, upgrades, integrity/drift gates, locking and rollback.

See [LEEME-SSOT.md](LEEME-SSOT.md) for input contracts and usage.

### Read applied and pending migrations

```sh
postgres-migrations status --ssot system.js --database database.js
```

Exit code: 0.

### Unsupported database environment

```sh
postgres-migrations apply --ssot system.js --database database.js
```

Exit code: 2.

### Database drift blocks apply

```sh
postgres-migrations apply --ssot system.js --database database.js
```

Exit code: 3.

### Uncertain commit remains blocked

```sh
postgres-migrations apply --ssot system.js --database database.js
```

Exit code: 4.

### Collect draft-bound data decisions

```sh
postgres-migrations resolve --draft draft.json --answers answers.json
```

Exit code: 0.
